stablePromotionGatesRemainSeparate: camera/device evidence or explicit experimental downgrade
deployment runtime verification with matching Release Attestation V1 fingerprint and valid Build Provenance V1

landingRules: Do not merge a child PR before its parent PR has landed or the child has been correctly rebased/retargeted.
Do not squash or reorder protocol-layer commits in a way that changes frozen vectors or provenance history without a new audit.
After each parent lands, refresh the next PR base and re-check the diff before merging it.
A mergeable=true GitHub state is not equivalent to merge authorization.
Independent executor or deployment evidence cannot be used to silently mark GitHub CI as PASS.
The Actions diagnostic localizes the current blocker but does not itself satisfy the CI gate.
The diagnostic workflow remains manual-only until account/platform state changes, to avoid redundant failing probes.
Vercel bootstrap is preview-only and cannot be used to authorize production or stable promotion.
A matching Release Attestation V1 fingerprint proves frozen RC1 runtime identity only and cannot promote stable, CI, Physical QA or HNK_CANON.
Build Provenance V1 is unhashed operational metadata; it can trace/pin a build but cannot change the frozen RC1 fingerprint or authorize promotion.
Promotion Readiness V1 may return READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW only after mandatory pre-human gates PASS; that status never authorizes merge, V1.0 stable or HNK_CANON.
Human Promotion Decision V1 records APPROVE/DEFER/REJECT only; even APPROVE_V1_0 does not execute merge, deployment, version changes or HNK_CANON promotion.
Promotion Execution Plan V1 is DRY_RUN_ONLY and its planFingerprint must verify before any authorization record is accepted.

Technical Execution Authorization V1 authorizes only listed step IDs on the exact fingerprinted plan; non-production scope never implies stable or production scope, and the record itself executes nothing.
HNK_CANON remains outside Technical Execution Authorization V1 and cannot be promoted through this release-operation pipeline.
Landing RC1 code does not by itself authorize V1.0 stable or HNK_CANON promotion.
